title: Mechanistic elucidation of enzymatic C-glycosylation: facilitation by proton transfer to UDP-glucose
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28592-28600
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02643A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Daisuke Terada, Taichi Inagaki, Miho Hatanaka
DFT calculations revealed a dual role of UDP-glucose in C-glycosylation: not only as a glucose donor but also as a base that accepts a proton from the substrate, thereby initiating the reaction.
